2.name: TEXT_CMNRADENTERSHPOSHAE_00077_A1_1
2.description: Inquire about entry into the Sastasha Seagrot.

5.name: TEXT_CMNRADENTERSHPOSHAE_00077_DPERJHA_5
5.description: While not yet fully confirmed, the Sastasha Seagrot is suspected of being a Serpent Reaver hideout. Needless to say, Limsa Lominsa cannot have individuals unknown to the thalassocracy waltzing in and out unchecked. I can grant you entry to the caves, but only if you have the proper authorization.

6.name: TEXT_CMNRADENTERSHPOSHAE_00077_SYSTEM_6
6.description: To enter the Sastasha Seagrot, you must be in a party of four Disciples of War or Magic with a level of 15 or higher. All members must also have made sufficient progress in the quest “It's Probably Pirates.”

7.name: TEXT_CMNRADENTERSHPOSHAE_00077_SYSTEM_7
7.description: Forays into Sastasha are limited to 90 minutes (Earth time).

8.name: TEXT_CMNRADENTERSHPOSHAE_00077_SYSTEM_8
8.description: Members level 19 and higher will be synced to level 18 upon entry.

9.name: TEXT_CMNRADENTERSHPOSHAE_00077_SYSTEM_9
9.description: All items in a player's loot list will automatically be transferred to that player's inventory upon all other party members leaving the area. Items unable to be obtained will be lost.

13.name: TEXT_CMNRADENTERSHPOSHAE_00077_SYSTEM_10
13.description: You were unable to enter <hex:022815FF10496E7374616E6365436F6E74656E74E8030403>. Make sure that you and your party meet all the conditions.

14.name: TEXT_CMNRADENTERSHPOSHAE_00077_DPERJHA_20
14.description: You don't have the look of a pirate, but one can never be too careful on this island. Unless you have the proper authorization, I can't let you enter the Sastasha Seagrot.

15.name: TEXT_CMNRADENTERSHPOSHAE_00077_SYSTEM_20
15.description: To enter Sastasha, you must have made sufficient progress in the quest “It's Probably Pirates.”
